one_line: Paramara ruler of Malwa who broke from Rashtrakuta overlordship and led a daring campaign to sack Manyakheta in the late 10th century.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean but strong build, the wiry endurance of an active campaigner rather than a bulky warrior.
appearance.face: Oval face with a sharp jawline, medium-deep brown complexion, straight nose, high cheekbones, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard framing the mouth and chin, with a small tilak mark on the forehead; default expression calm and watchful, shifting to focused intensity in battle.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair drawn back into a high, tight warrior’s knot (small topknot) at the crown, sides cleanly combed; a narrow gold circlet rests low on the forehead, with a small central red gemstone and a simple cloth under-band in deep maroon.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, knee-length cotton angarakha-style tunic in muted off-white, crossing right over left and tied with inner ties, over which sits a fitted sleeveless leather-coated vest reinforced with small metal plates sewn inside, dyed deep maroon; a broad woven cloth sash in indigo and maroon with a subtle geometric pattern wraps firmly around his waist, its end tucked and hanging to mid-thigh; his lower garment is a finely pleated dhoti-style wrap in soft beige tied securely for riding and battle, the pleats brought between the legs for ease of movement; over his shoulders is a light woolen shawl in dull olive green with a thin maroon border, usually draped over the left shoulder and pinned at the chest with a small circular bronze brooch; he wears simple but sturdy leather boots rising to mid-calf, laced in front, suitable for marching across the Narmada frontier; jewellery is restrained—a pair of small gold hoop earrings, a single thin gold armlet on the right bicep engraved with a subtle floral motif, and a plain signet ring on his right hand bearing the Paramara boar emblem.
appearance.signature: A straight, double-edged steel sword inspired by early medieval Indian khandas, with a broad, slightly tapering blade, a simple crossguard, and a rounded disc pommel; the hilt is wrapped in dark brown leather, and the sword is carried in a plain dark brown leather scabbard suspended from his indigo-and-maroon waist sash.

ref_desc: Siyaka II is a mid-30s, lean brown-complexioned man with an oval face, neat moustache and short beard, black hair in a high warrior’s knot under a narrow gold circlet, wearing an off-white angarakha, maroon reinforced vest, beige dhoti, olive shawl, indigo-and-maroon sash, leather boots, minimal gold jewellery, and carrying a double-edged straight sword in a dark brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Siyaka II, a mid-30s lean brown-complexioned Paramara ruler with an oval face, high cheekbones, straight nose, and a neat moustache with a short beard around his mouth and chin, his default expression calm and assessing; his thick black hair is pulled back into a high tight warrior’s knot at the crown and he wears a narrow gold circlet with a small red gemstone on his forehead, set over a thin maroon cloth band. Dress him in an off-white knee-length cotton angarakha tunic crossing right over left, over which sits a fitted sleeveless deep maroon vest subtly reinforced as if with small plates inside; wrap a broad indigo-and-maroon geometric-patterned cloth sash firmly around his waist, with its end tucked and hanging to mid-thigh. His lower garment is a beige pleated dhoti-style wrap secured for movement, with the pleats brought between the legs, and he wears sturdy dark brown leather mid-calf boots laced at the front. Drape a dull olive green light woolen shawl with a thin maroon border over his left shoulder, pinned at the chest with a small round bronze brooch. Add restrained jewellery: small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold armlet on his right bicep with a simple floral motif, and a plain ring with a boar emblem on his right hand. Show his signature weapon, a straight double-edged broad steel sword with a simple crossguard, disc pommel, and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, carried in a plain dark brown leather scabbard hanging from his sash. Use a colour palette dominated by off-white, deep maroon, indigo, olive green, beige, and dark brown, and present him from multiple angles to clarify face, hair, costume details, and the sword’s design.
